audit_method: Read-only audit of the current agy recognizer and real isolated PTY captures. Closed-source CLI; no exhaustive source-menu audit or installed-binary menu completeness claim.

capture_contract.cursor_evidence: Matching *.cursor.txt files from the same real ptyhost captures; coordinates are zero-based.
capture_contract.permissions_evidence: 07-permissions-menu.screen.txt and screen.raw identified by sessiondock-agy-evidence-report.md; limited emulator has old-frame residues, so only confirmed menu layout is reconstructed.

fixture_method: Main captures preserve ANSI styles and cursor coordinates after replacing temporary cwd. Trust No focus is a labelled synthetic variation of captured rows. Negative mutations are labelled synthetic; permissions scope uses confirmed captured text with stale fragments removed.
audit_coverage: Real 1.2.17 isolated PTY and Chromium: command once/deny/cancel/amend, session and persistent grants with next-command checks; create-file approval/full diff; ask_question single/multiple/back/submit/write-in; /model, /permissions, /resume, /help and /settings open/close. Existing 1.2.16 captures retained. Not an exhaustive closed-source menu audit.

key_semantics.model: Captured single sessiondock-fake (current): Enter selects, Escape goes back. No manufactured model navigation/search keys.
key_semantics.permission_scope: Up/Down/Enter relative to captured Project focus; Escape closes. No deep rule edit, save or permission grant claimed.
key_semantics.command_permission: Up/Down/Enter relative to current focus; Escape interrupts. Tab opens approval-plus-next-instruction input, retained in native terminal. Grant scope is included verbatim.
key_semantics.file_permission: Create-file yes/no, Escape; Tab amendment and f full diff (Escape returns to approval).
key_semantics.question: Up/Down/Enter single select; Space multi toggle, Enter submit/next, Left/Right disclosed page navigation; Escape skips. Write-in empty field uses data plus Enter; a preexisting native draft remains native.

categories.reason: Real empty /resume footer/layout is not recognized; populated lists not audited.
Real 1.2.17 Project rule editor inspected; complex rule editing remains native.
Native 1.2.17 command and create-file approvals; other tool approval families remain unverified.
Real menu opening/closing and no original-command native echo verified; settings values/search and help tabs remain native.

unknown_fallback: Other menu families, undisclosed rows, multi-select, text/search editing, paging, secrets and authorization forms are unaudited and remain native unless the existing recognizer matches a complete verified shape. No assertion that these families exist in this version.
limitations: Closed-source screen recognizer is not a guarantee of all current/future menus.
Command amendment text, full diff, deep settings/permission editors and populated resume selection retain native terminal controls.
Only empty write-in fields permit web text submission; existing native drafts are never overwritten.
